description: DIN 580 lifting eye bolt: a threaded shank, a cylindrical collar, and a forged circular lifting eye (a torus loop) integral on top, as one connected solid. The shank carries a modelled external metric thread (ISO 261 coarse pitch helical V-groove). The eye and collar are fixed proportions of the nominal thread diameter (collar Ø 2 d, collar height 0.8 d, eye ring centreline radius 1.15 d, eye wire radius 0.55 d); the nominal thread size is the size driver and the shank length is a free dimension.
source: DIN 580 lifting eye bolt (metric thread series); eye/collar proportions are proportion relative to the nominal thread diameter; ISO 261 coarse pitch
